description: Switch a release on or off the list other artists on Audora see on release day, to give it a first listen. Refused for a release out more than four weeks ago or released elsewhere.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

idempotency_key.description: Send the same key if you retry, and it happens once.

name: set_first_listen
title: First listen on release day
